She began by accepting online or phone commissions, and drones could often be spotted delivering broken equipment to her room, or repaired equipment back to their owners. As no one had seen her in person at the time, rumors began to spread that she was too overweight to leave her room.

lore.title: Archive File 2
lore.text:
[Audio Log]
'Hey, did you hear about how a bunch of operators in Medical called in sick?'
'A pathogen leak? Or just overwork from having too many patients?'
'No, I heard there was something involving some rarely used medical equipment in the old storage room...'
'Old storage room? You don't mean the one that used to...'
'Exactly, which is why no one's been in there for ages. Anyway, it was bad enough to have to go into that dark, scary place, but then they started hearing strange voices.'
'What?'
'Not only that, the white cloth covering the equipment started swaying eerily. One of them even saw a semi-transparent figure in a corner!'

[Announcement from the Medical Department]
The Medical Department has completed its preliminary investigation into the rumors surrounding the so-called 'Mystery of the Storage Room.' To protect the privacy of those involved, no public report will be issued. However, in order to prevent similar incidents in the future, the Medical Department hereby announces the following regulations:
1. Without express permission, no drones or other appliances with voice or holographic projection functions are permitted into restricted areas, including surgery rooms, intensive care units, and equipment storage rooms.
2. Non-Medical personnel who wish to study the medical equipment may submit a request to Dr. Kal'tsit in writing. Or just come to the surgery room. Don't use hacking and drones for this sort of thing!
3. Don't use 'studying medical equipment' as an excuse to scare people with drones!
4. Don't deliver your written request via drone! Come in person!

lore.title: Archive File 3
lore.text:
Operator Spuria previously worked as a communications engineer at the Laterano Municipal Office. She currently works for the Sixth Tribunal, which is responsible for civic matters, education, and health. Although she is known to be eccentric even by the standards of our other Lateran operators, she is quite willing to use her tech skills to help people solve small issues in exchange for repayment, such as rescuing trapped pets, manipulating traffic signals and school bells, or other 'interesting' problems.
While she was a student, she was repeatedly disciplined for hacking the school bells. In one case, a sociology teacher showed signs of dehydration after lecturing for five hours straight, without a bell to signal the end of the period. Investigations revealed that Spuria had disabled the school's timekeeping system. When questioned, she answered, 'I just wanted him to take up the classroom a little while longer so I wouldn't have to go to tech ethics class. How was I supposed to know he could talk that long?'
Despite numerous incidents, Spuria was never expelled. While she rarely attended class, she helped the school develop a highly efficient system for teaching and administration, greatly reducing administrative workload. This is also why she was able to remove any disciplinary action from her record. The headmaster even waived her attendance requirements after she secured him the best seats at a popular singer's concert. While the school may have turned a blind eye to her eccentricities, she did receive 'discipline' from other sources, such as Lemuen, the head prefect of the student council. While no record remains of their interactions as students, the two of them are known to be close, even now.
Interestingly, Spuria was recommended to the Curia not long after Lemuen recovered from her injuries and joined the Seventh Tribunal, responsible for intelligence, foreign affairs, and national defense. Spuria was first offered a post at the Seventh Tribunal as well, but surprisingly she declined, preferring to work at the civic-focused Sixth Tribunal.
'Technology exists to be used. It's only fitting that my drone goes to class in my place!'
'You want to skip class, and I want you to attend.
'So how about this: Either you get up in the next 10 minutes, or I give your teacher and classmates a call, and let you explain to them the little drone you invented.'

lore.title: Archive File 4
lore.text:
Inquiries with Operators Spuria, Insider, and Executor have helped us piece together a picture of what happened at the Sanctilaminium Ambrosii. After expressing our condolences for what the inhabitants had been through, we determined that the tragedy could not have been averted by the efforts of a few, and that Spuria and the others present would benefit from moving on. While we do not believe that she is responsible for Fortuna's fall, it was apparent that she continues to feel guilt over it.
We were concerned that, after witnessing the fall of a Sankta from up close, Spuria would associate what happened with the 'unusual choice' she made. However, from what we've observed, she is not trying to shoulder responsibility for the entire incident herself. Indeed, her feelings of guilt have actually had a positive influence on her.
Since her student days, Operator Spuria has devoted her full attention to the study of precision technology, but only out of curiosity and laziness. Lemuen helped her realize that the technology she knew had little practical application, which led her to join the civic-focused Sixth Tribunal. Then, the fall of Fortuna made her rethink her responsibility towards guns as a Sankta, and she realized that her expertise in firearms technology could help more Sankta fulfill their own responsibilities and prevent future tragedies. This was the practical value of technology she had sought.
Operator Spuria takes regular shore leaves, revealing little about the purpose of these trips other than that she is helping out the Sixth Tribunal. We have strong reason to believe, however, that she is visiting Fortuna and carrying out her 'duty of oversight.'

lore.title: Promotion Record
lore.text:

'Fortuna has actually settled in with those Sarkaz, so I can finally take my eyes off her for a while. Taking a walk around their new home and eliminating any potential threats is a kind of oversight, right?'

lore.title: Profile
lore.text: Cliffheart is a Rhodes Island Operator who was born in Kjerag. She is a specialist in rock and mountain climbing and is proficient with all kinds of climbing tools. Currently she is undergoing treatment for Oripathy at Rhodes Island.

lore.title: Clinical Analysis
lore.text:
Imaging tests have shown the outlines of her internal organs to be indistinct due to abnormal shadows. Originium granules have been detected in her circulatory system, confirming her to be infected with Oripathy.

[Cell-Originium Fusion Rate] 7%
Due to puncturing by an Originium stone, Operator exhibits visible Originium crystals at the puncture site.

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.28u/L
Course of infection is transitioning to the middle-term but has not yet had a significant impact upon the infected.

lore.title: Archive File 1
lore.text: Cliffheart is a natural explorer and climber. Her reflexes and endurance far exceed what normal people could think possible. With even the simplest of items, Cliffheart is capable of traversing obstacles that would stop most people in their tracks. Cliffheart is more comfortable using her climbing instruments than a traditional melee weapon. Even on the battlefield, she uses these tools as weapons. Don't question the power of her snow spade or ice pick - in the hands of the right person, even instruments such as these can be lethal.

lore.title: Archive File 2
lore.text: While attempting to climb the holy mountain, Cliffheart was pierced by an Originium stone during an unexpected landslide and thus became Infected. Fortunately, most of the people of Kjerag hold no prejudice against the Infected, and Cliffheart still managed to lead a normal life. Still, in order to make the Originium crystals on her body not appear so conspicuous, she takes clever steps to hide it. Thus, even outside Kjerag, she is free to move as she pleases.

lore.title: Archive File 3
lore.text: As a member of the Silverash Family, she garners a lot of attention despite not appearing as elite as her older brother and sister. Unlike her siblings, she is not bound by any official position and thus is free to speak. Therefore, she often mingles with the common people, listening to their stories, learning about their lives, and studying their skills. She then uses these things she's learned to contribute to her clan.

lore.title: Archive File 4
lore.text: Whatever peace the Silverash Family had came to an end when Pramanix was anointed saint. SilverAsh could no longer interacted with Cliffheart in the open, and Pramanix couldn't communicate with either of them because of her newfound official position. This made Cliffheart furious, but she understood that there was no way for the three of them to be as they once were. There was nothing she could do to fix the situation, and this feeling of helplessness made her disheartened for the first time in her life. Still, if there were anything she could do to reunite with her brother and sister, she gladly do what it takes.

lore.title: Promotion Record
lore.text: Cliffheart seems to always instill feelings of cheer and optimism in those she meets, though her soul burns with the desire to inflict mischief. If you bite into a piece of cake only to find it full of beans, or your employee card has gone missing, there's a high probability that Cliffheart is responsible. If not, then she'll likely find out who is. Making mischief and exposing other mischief makers are two of her favorite pastimes.

lore.title: Profile
lore.text:
Operator Snowsant, a native of Lungmen, has a rich experience in scientific research from the various high-tech development zones of Columbia.
After returning to Lungmen to develop her home town, she signed a contract with Rhodes Island during the following period.

lore.title: Clinical Analysis
lore.text:
Imaging tests reveal clear, normal outlines of internal organs, and no abnormal shadows have been detected. Originium granules have not been detected in the circulatory system and there are no other signs of infection. At this time, this operator can be confirmed to be uninfected.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 0%
Operator Snowsant shows no signs of Oripathy infection.

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.14u/L
Due to scientific research and related reasons, Snowsant comes into contact with Originium on occasion. Though there is almost no risk of infection, regular inspections are still required.

lore.title: Archive File 1
lore.text:
A hard worker from birth, Snowsant was born into the lower class and became a self-taught student only through her own efforts. She invested her hard-earned savings to head to Columbia to pursue her dreams.
According to an investigation into her resume, Snowsant once settled in a well-known high-tech development zone in Columbia, working as a researcher in a notorious private research institute. Since this small-scale institute did not produce any results of importance, we once dismissed her research capabilities.
But when we delved into the papers titled 'Next-Generation Convenience Improvements for Floor-Sweeping Robots' and 'A Mechanical Clawhook That Will Never Become Loose (Haven't Thought of a Good Use Yet),' we came to reevaluate Snowsant in a different light.
After all, nothing serves as a better testimony to Snowsant's vigorous and enthusiastic work ethic than the fact that she went all-out even when researching things that probably don't matter at all. This misunderstanding was likely caused by the fact that she was excluded from the field for a long period of time, and did not have the opportunity to enter the high-tech field. In fact, Snowsant is even more talented than she is aware of. Compared to those geniuses that are prone to crashing and burning, a steadfast researcher who has never stopped inching forward seems to be more worthy of Rhodes Island's attention.

lore.title: Archive File 2
lore.text:
The story of 'Snowsant's Coin' was once popular among younger Operators, without any malicious intent of course.
Once, during one of Dobermann's speeches that dragged on for dozens of minutes, Snowsant's eyes were fixated upon the instructor's feet the entire time. As soon as Dobermann concluded her speech, Snowsant immediately shot up and approached Dobermann - nobody had ever seen her move so quickly before. Then, she bent over - in front of everyone in the room, picked up a coin, and stood back up. Even Dobermann did not know how to react at that time. Though Snowsant quickly seemed to realize her rude behavior, she stood there for a few seconds before shuffling back to her seat, trembling in front of the whole room.
We later learned that her purse had a small hole in it, and the purse was filled with coins that she had painstakingly scrounged up. Surprisingly, though Snowsant was fidgeting around for the coin almost the entire meeting, her notes were almost identical to what was given by Dobermann. We hope that the Operators prone to falling asleep during meetings can learn a thing or two from her diligence.
Although sometimes this diligence reaches a level that makes others worried about her health, most Operators watch over her fondly as this frail girl carefully and painstakingly goes about her work.

lore.title: Archive File 3
lore.text:
Somehow, Miss Jessica and Miss Snowsant have developed a good relationship.
During a certain equipment maintenance job, Jessica struck up a conversation with Snowsant. Perhaps due to their shared similarities - both girls being kind, hard-working, and conscientious, the two quickly came to understand each other, and sympathized with and admired each others' experiences.
Of course, in the eyes of outsiders, these two girls also have strikingly similar weaknesses. There are too many talented people surrounding them, which makes them underestimate their abilities, and they compensate through an almost stubborn work ethic, taking one step at a time.
However, despite understanding each other in many regards and confiding in each other, after learning about Jessica's monthly expenditures on firearms, equipment, and Originium bullets, Snowsant once questioned Jessica's grasp of currency and basic mathematical knowledge. If you see the two eating together at a cafeteria, don't be surprised if you see Snowsant with an empty tray in front of her. While Jessica is certainly capable of helping Snowsant financially, she also knows the value of the sacrifices Snowsant is willing to make for her ideals. Perhaps, the two of them really can become each others' emotional pillar of support.

lore.title: Archive File 4
lore.text:
If Rhodes Island has a 'paragon of frugality,' that would be none other than Snowsant.
According to her own account, before traveling to Columbia, she lived a bare-bones life in Lungmen. Even after her scholarships and salary from the research institute eased her financial burdens, she continued her frugality in order to fund her independent research and development projects.
From the smallest of things, such as turning off the lights before going outside or recycling whatever she could, Snowsant had precise calculations and plans for all her daily expenses. After rigorously withholding what she needed for her research funds and squeezing anything out of her living expenses, she would send whatever was left over back to her hometown.
It is worth mentioning the industrial clawhooks that Snowsant carries with her. Reportedly, this clawhook is the first scientific achievement that Snowsant made by herself before leaving Lungmen. Obviously, she had no idea how to use patent rights and marketing to turn a profit for herself. She simply took this clawhook to participate in a certain regional industrial design competition, relying on the meager proceeds to buy a one-way ticket to Columbia to begin chasing her dreams.
Snowsant has little confidence in her abilities, and though I don't know when, some very successful people who understood the value of her quiet diligence turned their attention towards her and invited her back to Lungmen when the time was right.

lore.title: Promotion Record
lore.text:
During her hardest time in Columbia, Snowsant repeatedly missed research opportunities due to exclusion and discrimination. When Snowsant learned that the few scientific achievements she made had been plagiarized by the institute and registered under another person's name to secure research funds, she could only helplessly shuffle through the bustling streets of Columbia. Under the crushing weight of utter disappointment, she took out the lucky charm bag that her grandmother had prepared for her. Within it was but a piece of paper with the four words: 'Heaven rewards the hardworking.'
Though useless for her situation, Snowsant cheered up and found solace in those words.
Heaven rewards the hardworking, and the proverb became reality.
Three days later, Snowsant received an invitation from officials in Lungmen's upper echelons. Though the research institute tried to persuade her to stay upon learning this news, Snowsant eventually rejected the institute's offer and returned to her hometown with a deep longing in her heart.

lore.title: Profile
lore.text:
Laura Arias, an engineering expert from Blacksteel Worldwide. She possesses remarkable technical acumen for her age and has rich, practical experience in fields such as mechanical engineering and automation. She's provided critical technical support to numerous Blacksteel operations.
During the latest round of exchange projects between the two companies, Laura personally applied to be deployed to Rhodes Island as a dispatch operator. Now, she works with Engineering on its R&D projects as a special technology consultant, and she's no slouch either.

lore.title: Clinical Analysis
lore.text:
Imaging tests show the indistinct outlines of internal organs, obscured by abnormal shadows. Originium granules detected in the circulatory system. The subject is confirmed to be infected with Oripathy.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 4%
Small traces of crystallization are visible on Operator Almond's body surface.

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.19u/L
Operator Almond's BOCD is trending upwards. Fortunately, her condition has not worsened.
Considering how often she goes into the engine layer of nomadic plates, ventures deep inside energy towers, and even hangs out in front of active power plants, she should consider herself lucky that she's as healthy as she is.

lore.title: Archive File 1
lore.text:
When it comes to engineering experts, Almond is a rare breed: the kind that talks way too much.
Many Engineering operators still remember how, the moment she set foot in Engineering, Almond started expressing her opinions on every project and prototype she spotted, as well as joining in on the engineers' discussions with no reservations whatsoever. Rather than putting her head down to work, she'd much rather talk it out in a group and facilitate teamwork. By lucky coincidence, this is exactly how Rhodes Island tends to work. Aside from helping her fit in right away, her bottomless blabbermouth quickly dispelled the image of a young, accomplished engineer everyone had of her, and without attracting any animosity.
Almond talks fast, but her words are clear and distinct, and she is confident in the way she expresses herself. When discussing things such as budget and safety, her conversations balloon to double the normal length (and when talking about useless crap, quadruple the length). When expressing her opinions, she starts with her conclusion before going into each individual issue, such that everyone can clearly understand what she has to say. She always gets straight to the point. Surprisingly, however, her look of concentration while talking has also become a topic of interest among certain operators.

'Did you see that?! After just five minutes of talking, she figured out how the Type I02 Originium internal combustion engine works, and even arranged for the follow-up work right after. Amazing how quickly she solved the explosion risk.'
'Oh... Laura's cheeks look so red when she's talking. I wanna pinch them so much—'
—The private conversation of two Engineering Department operators

lore.title: Archive File 2
lore.text:
It's worth noting that money—or more accurately, funding—holds a very important position in Almond's way of life.
If she sees life as a large engineering project, then currency must be its energy source, the key to the entire system's operation. In which case, her keen nose for and stubborn pursuit of funding must have some kind of hard-to-explain connection to her outstanding insight as an engineer. 'Funding doesn't solve every engineering problem, but you can't get anything done without funding.' Almond has proven through her actions that she takes this mantra to heart. Her total number of budget applications each quarter is consistently number one within the department, and she always provides the most diverse reasons in them:
—'The tensile strength is way below standards. We gotta change the entire outer shell to Fuscous Fiber!'
—'This is an emergency! We need to add a new sewage system to the control room!'
—'The technicians are passing out! We need a new filtration system ASAP!'
Although the amount of funding she seeks is truly terrifying, and she often falls behind on progress milestones, Almond's need for funding is by no means baseless or unfounded. She gives each and every line item in her budget careful consideration, and has clear entries in her accounts to back everything up. As for her seemingly absurd reasons, the vast majority of them are a testament to her hard work at pushing boundaries.
As it turns out, all of her research results are proof of her talent and how forward-thinking she is.

[Voice Log]
'My mom's a doctor, my grandma's an engineer, and my dad's a househusband. When we first moved to Columbia, it was hard to find work. My family was very poor, and my dad had to figure out how to stretch a single loaf of rye bread to feed the whole family for a day.
'My grandma made my tools, and the money I spent on my equipment came from my mom working night shifts. The only parts I could use were scraps from the workshops...
'I'm sure you know, but people who grew up like me never waste a cent. Please... just a little more funding. Just a teensy bit.'
'How many times have you given us that same sob story? But the problem here isn't the budget... Why don't you take another look at the reason you put on the form?
'The pink paintjob looks so lame...'
'No duh it does! That's a special suspension arm! We need to paint it neon green to suit the needs of nighttime work!'

lore.title: Archive File 3
lore.text:
Of all her coworkers from Blacksteel, Jessica is the one that Laura worries about the most. From a bystander's point of view, perhaps 'Jessica's family is loaded' is reason enough for Laura to befriend her, but interestingly enough, it was Jessica who laid the groundwork for their friendship.
Laura was infected with Oripathy after graduating from college, and was forced to give up on a job offer from a tech company and join Blacksteel Worldwide instead, known for its tolerance of the Infected. Yet before this, Laura had no experience getting along with mercenaries. As to be expected, on her first mission, the mercenaries already had strong doubts about the green engineer's unusual ideas. And when Laura found herself in that difficult position, it was Jessica who stepped forward to support her plan as well as persuade the other mercenaries to trust her.
When questioned about this afterward, Jessica noted that she saw a bit of her old self in Laura, from back when no one believed in her. It was through the trust of Liskarm and Franka that she finally mustered her confidence. But regardless, she thought that Laura also deserved a chance to be believed in, and Laura responded to her trust with results. This is how their friendship began.

[Blacksteel Worldwide - Operational Records]
Inquiry Scope: Laura Arias, Jessica Brynley
Control Clearance: Liskarm
......
'Jessica, why didn't you follow the plan and use the equipment I set up?! Do you know how bad things can get if you don't follow regulations?!
'You see that big wheel spinning really fast? Your hand almost got caught in it! You see all this sweat? That's how anxious you made me!
'You're always like this. Last time, and the time before that, and the time before... Don't give me that teary-eyed look. I'm not falling for it! Don't think I'm gonna go easy on you!'
'You... You said that would buy the workers more time. B-But, have you considered how dangerous of a situation that would put you in?
'......
'*sob*... What do I even do with you, Jessica? I've talked to you about this so many times already...
'Leave me alone. I'm not crying. Go away!
'Waah... Go away. I'm not eating any dessert you're buying me...
'*sob*... You say we're going to that restaurant you need to reserve a year in advance?
'...What're you laughing at? I'm gonna eat till I drop! Hmph.. Don't you look at me with those teary eyes then!'

lore.title: Archive File 4
lore.text:
'There's a flame burning in Almond's eyes.'
An Engineering operator described the scene she saw that night. She remembers Almond working overtime in the laboratory, and that she was bringing her a cup of hot cystymilk, but when she opened the door, she found Almond frowning as she stared intently at the computational model running on the screen, the simulated flame reflected right in her eyes. The operator was shocked, as she had never seen such an expression on her face, but when Almond turned around and started chatting with her, that expression was nowhere to be seen.
Then, as she spent more and more time onboard Rhodes Island, more and more people started to realize that her petite body packed a huge amount of energy, as though at a moment's notice she could leap high into the sky to snatch something. Almond's lively personality may give the impression that 'she's very laid-back.' But in reality, the amount of effort she puts in has reached a level her coworkers could only dream of. She is able to lock herself in the laboratory all day, repeatedly work out the projects' most minute details with her team members, or run all over the place to secure the funding she needs. Motor systems and safety are two of her top concerns, and to obtain perfect performance numbers, she is willing to pull multiple all-nighters testing in the lab. Once, she was even found passed out in front of a work table.
Yet, when others ask her why she's willing to go to such lengths, she always answers evasively with excuses like 'my career' and 'dreams,' but no amount of questioning can get her to elaborate on those dreams. Some were worried that, as a Blacksteel employee, perhaps her participation in Rhodes Island R&D projects implied some kind of ulterior motive, though these rumors were quickly dispelled after her projects kept yielding results, while her attitude toward work remained unchanged.
Even after her cystymilk had gone cold, she continued to stare at the screen. Compared to what she had lost, she thought she had yet to achieve enough, to jump high enough.

[Voice Log]
Sometimes, I still dream of that morning we left Bolívar. The sky was pretty dark, and the shocked fowlbeasts were flying in circles above us. Mom loaded the last crate onto the car, I sat down on the crate, and then the engine started to roar under my butt.
The car started to move, and it got faster and faster. There was a loud boom. My dad covered my ears. I could make out where the fireball had landed. That was where our house used to be. My mom's medical certificate, my grandma's workshop, and all the dolls I couldn't bring with me were all still there.
I looked at it again, and all I could see was a firelight soaring up into the sky. There was nothing left.

lore.title: Promotion Record
lore.text:
Under normal circumstances, Almond is very easy to get along with. There is, however, one special exception.
Simply put, you shouldn't overdo it when you tease her. Say, when you give her apple wedges, don't sneak in a slice of onion. Or when she's focused on her work, don't suddenly hug her and hold her up, lifting her feet off the ground.
Whenever similar situations occur, all the anger that's welled up in the bottom of her heart is immediately unleashed.
Trust me, you don't want to know what it's like.

lore.title: Profile
lore.text:
Much of Manticore's history is unknown. It is known that prior to her employment at Rhodes Island, she had engaged in the 'removal' of certain individuals. She has excellent stealth, infiltration, and surprise attack skills.
Now she serves as a special kind of Operator who provides these unique services for Rhodes Island.

lore.title: Clinical Analysis
lore.text:
Imaging tests have shown the outlines of her internal organs to be indistinct due to abnormal shadows. Originium granules have been detected in her circulatory system, confirming her to be infected with Oripathy.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 12%
Operator has no obvious ore lesions on the surface of her body. Tests have revealed the presence of crystals internally, however.

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.32u/L
Due to the presence of Originium within the Operator's internal organs, the Operator's shows an elevated blood crystal content.

lore.title: Archive File 1
lore.text:
Manticore is gentle, shy, and sometimes even gives others the feeling that she's afraid. She speaks in a hesitant tone and often stammers. She rarely finishes a sentence in one attempt, and she appears very stiff when communicating with other Operators. She would probably be more comfortable talking to a rock.
Additionally, her rare invisibility ability has become a major hindrance to communication. It has completely prevented her from improving her interpersonal skills. It may be necessary to suggest additional treatment solutions to help Manticore develop her social skills.

lore.title: Archive File 2
lore.text:
We communicate with Manticore by writing messages on paper. Oripathy has given her the ability to turn invisible (the report on this ability needs additional processing). It has been confirmed through interactive experiments that her ability does not transfer to inanimate objects, so paper communication has proved a suitable way to communicate with this operator.
After communication, Manticore likes to leave behind little gifts that smell sweetly of violets.

lore.title: Archive File 3
lore.text:
Manticore was born in Sargon. Because most of the background she provided could not be validated, Manticore's experience cannot be confirmed. What is known is that Manticore has undergone relatively comprehensive special operations training and has at least one year of operative experience under her belt.
The investigation into her special operations training unit was unsuccessful, and Sargon intelligence did not provide any valuable clues. Currently only unconfirmed and less than reliable intelligence from Sargon spies indicate there is a group of people who house Originium Arts users with special abilities in this area. These individuals are using special training methods to kill Sargon aristocrats or operatives from other nations.
Because of Manticore's vague background, she has been designated a special type of Oripathy patient at Rhodes Island. Any applications requesting use of Manticore in special operations or combat will first need to be submitted to Dr. Kal'tsit for approval.

lore.title: Archive File 4
lore.text:
[Manticore's Ability's Test Record]
Test subject: Manticore.
Test objective: To probe the usefulness of the subject's abilities and Originium Arts.
Test content: To find Manticore while she is in hiding and to defend against her while she is in action.
Test participants: An Operator who has worked with Manticore on several missions.
Randomly select two Operators from all of the Operators available.
Among them must be at least one technician Operator or non-technician Operator with high Originium adaptability.
Test results: The test took place on a terrain simulating a complex environment. During the test period, none of the three Operators were able to locate the whereabouts of Manticore. When Manticore went on the offensive, some of the Operators managed to defend against her attacks using their quick reaction times and combat experience, while Manticore managed to successfully attack the others.
Feedback results: According to the explanations provided by the Operators, Manticore could not be captured using visual means. Some of the Operators with better Originium adaptability reported feeling a strange atmosphere that instantly made them as though they were in danger.
The above process has been recorded in its entirety. If you wish to view it, you must request it from the relevant department.

lore.title: Profile
lore.text: Higashi student Kirara, chose to leave home due to her Oripathy. After sending out an SOS message to her former classmates, she got a reply from Utage and sought treatment from Rhodes Island following instructions. Has a considerable understanding of electronic equipment. Presently providing assistance to Rhodes Island with broadcast communications and equipment maintenance.

lore.title: Clinical Analysis
lore.text:
Imaging tests show the indistinct outlines of internal organs, obscured by abnormal shadows. Originium granules detected in the circulatory system. The subject is confirmed to be infected with Oripathy.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 5%
Operator Kirara has been infected by Originium, with minor amounts of crystals visible on the surface of her body.

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.17u/L
Kirara's infection was only an accident. In daily life, she rarely comes into contact with Originium. So long as her situation holds steady, the chance of her condition worsening is particularly small.

lore.title: Archive File 1
lore.text:
Kirara comes from a small-scale nomadic city in the south of Higashi, falling under the jurisdiction of Mitsumoto, the southern ruling bloc. The town borders the sea, the surrounding land level, rich in resources in all respects, and so a commercial economy has developed, trading fairly closely with its surrounding city regions.
At the same time, since it lies far from Higashi's internal two-power line of contention, Kirara's hometown has been less affected by the dispute. Prior to Kirara's own unfortunate contraction of Oripathy, she had been living a proper, stable life as a student should have, her only worry about the tumult of war being whether games produced by the north could make it safely across the chaos zone, for a smooth delivery by their hired shinobi.

lore.title: Archive File 2
lore.text:
As a patient who was introduced by Operator Utage, it never occurred to Kirara at the outset to find work at Rhodes Island, and become a formal Operator like her classmate Utage. For the introverted girl, Rhodes Island offering her treatment for Oripathy also gave her somewhere to stay for a while, and for the money she paid as compensation, it was quite a worthwhile deal. At first, that's all it was.
However, plans are where the little things always go awry. While the Higashi girl would shut herself in her room the majority of the time, using SMS in place of verbal dialogue, and making maximum efforts possible to avoid interacting directly with others, on her occasional 'outings,' she'd always come back having helped some operators while she was out, at times resolving some minor issues with electronic equipment, or being entrusted ad-hoc with instructing operators on how to work appliances, and once she'd even been pursued with inquiries for a walkthrough of a popular game at the time... In short, before Kirara herself even realized it, she was already on fairly good terms with our operators.
We very quickly sent a formal invitation to this Higashi girl, inviting her to become one.
Gratefully, fearful of strangers as she was, she didn't decline.

lore.title: Archive File 3
lore.text:
In Higashi, lineages of Ægir that migrated in and settled down like Kirara's are not uncommon to see. In contrast to our understanding of Iberia's internal situation, Higashi's Ægir by and large have not been faced with overt exclusion, putting down roots in the country without a problem. In the present day, Kirara's own recognition of herself tells the tale—without any weight to it, she can say 'I'm just a normal Higashi girl, that's all.'
However, as is plain to see, stemming from different environs in upbringing, Kirara and other Higashi operators—for example, Operator Matoimaru—have differing conceptions of many things, despite being fellow Higashi.

'The north? Uh... I'm not too clued in about what Kougon's like, but I hear everyone's pretty old-timey there?'
When Kirara introduced her homeland Higashi to us, she raised the subject of its two ceaselessly warring powers, each one occupying one half of the country, exerting their governances on familially unified grounds.
'Mitsumoto didn't seem as heavily armed as the guys over there.' When regarding the contrast in power between her own home faction and the opposition, Kirara first skirted around the topic, only conceding after a while that 'if the fight started, then on a face-to-face battlefield it'd be pretty hard to win... b—but, direct conflict isn't the only thing that goes into who wins and loses! Besides, it's not like it's just war and life's on pause. When it comes to economy, openness and good atmosphere—livability, that's it—then it's us who come out on top, right? Uh, not that they're bad or anything, just, that's how I feel about it at least.'
Beyond this, the Higashi girl also somewhat regretfully, and somewhat barbedly stated:
'Honestly, if we could just not fight, then let's not. The past few years have been pretty good. Been peaceful for a while. Sometimes I buy games from over there and shinobi even deliver them straight to me. But after I heard about it, it seemed kind of difficult to say. Um. I'm not really sure, I don't get it much myself.'
'I heard the eight families used to be one, but then they disagreed on something and that's why they've been split across ever since... *sigh* Honestly, isn't it kind of an overdone premise? What's the point? It's just a bunch of brothers infighting, isn't it?'

lore.title: Archive File 4
lore.text:
Operator Kirara's interests and hobbies are startlingly expansive, with a major love for all niche entertainment comprised in novels, manga, games, etc.—though she had no choice but to leave her home, Kirara insisted on bringing more than half her collection with her, leaving people speechless. Aside from that, music is also one of Kirara's passions; before catching Oripathy, Kirara used to have a part-time job at a bar near her home, and putting on music to fit each day's mood was one of her daily joys.
Per her own absorptions, Kirara has spent considerable time and energy, even at times near the point of foregoing sleep and food, throwing her whole devotion into games or manga. The shut-off manner in which she refused interaction initially worried people, but as we've spent more time knowing her, we've been quick to realize that it's not that Kirara truly opposes interacting with people, but rather, it's a self-defense mechanism of sorts, stemming from a mentality of fearing being hurt.
This fear is closely related to Kirara's experiences as a child. During childhood, her reserved character and her interests unlike those of the children around her led to her being bullied. The experience of being ostracized still has an effect on Kirara to this day; she fears that when she bares her own soul and displays her true self, she may well be rejected or attacked, and so she has preemptively avoided contact with others.
However, should you break past Kirara's inner defenses, and be recognized as a close friend, it'll be clear for anyone to see that the true way she treats people is sincere, passionate, and without any reservation.

lore.title: Promotion Record
lore.text:
There is always some way to clear a game.
So long as one makes the right choices, the people in the screen will turn to them and smile. So long as one strives hard enough, the enemy can be defeated and a good ending welcomed.
But reality...
There are no retries in reality. Reality has no choice that reliably wins others over and earns one smiles. Failures in reality cannot be done over, and that is why we dread and are scared of ruining everything.
But, if one has companions willing to confront the elements with them, face the trials together...
Just maybe, things are no longer as scary as when one was all alone.

lore.title: Profile
lore.text: Bassist of Ave Mujica, introduced to Rhodes Island by Iris. She always displays outstanding professionalism, be it in combat or in performance.

lore.title: Clinical Analysis
lore.text:
Imaging tests reveal clear, normal outlines of internal organs, and no abnormal shadows have been detected. Originium granules have not been detected in the circulatory system and there is no sign of infection. At this time, this operator is believed to be uninfected.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 0%
Umiri Yahata shows no signs of Originium infection.

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] Undisclosed
The Medical Department has agreed not to disclose the relevant data.

lore.title: Archive File 1
lore.text:
Our first impression was that Ave Mujica was merely a student band that had stumbled upon Rhodes Island. Our thinking changed, however, as they blended into Rhodes, and began to ask how they could help.
We were surprised at how quickly Umiri Yahata absorbed new knowledge and put it into practice, and how she took the initiative in communication and working with others, supporting her team in the same way that the bass supports the rest of the band.
She is always calm, never flustered regardless of the situation—at least, so we thought.

lore.title: Archive File 2
lore.text:
'Umiri helps out our planning work here at Rhodes. She'll draft us a whole array of plans, all of them easy to understand and execute on. She's highly reliable, and we owe more than our fair share to her.'
A very fast learner, Umiri quickly earned the trust of many teams with her thorough planning and schedule management.
She is quick to grasp the mission objective and see it through without a hitch, making her the ideal partner.
'She's a serious and brisk worker, but there's always this distance between her and us...' So operators who work with her may feel on occasion, but quickly dismiss it, assuming they're just overthinking it.

lore.title: Archive File 3
lore.text:
It is true that Umiri has kept her distance from those around her, but it is not because she is wary of others.
She was overly eager in her first band, frequently giving instructions that she believed would help the band succeed, but ended up drawing the ire of the other band members, causing the band to fall apart.

lore.title: Archive File 4
lore.text:
It is easy to forget that Umiri is still a young student facing challenges appropriate to her age, so outstanding are her bass skills and management ability.
She pushes herself hard with a schedule that is packed to the brim between work and practice, as well as a rigorous training regimen.
Despite her image of perfection, Umiri can find it stressful when things do not go according to plan. Binge shopping at the Rhodes Island shop is her way of blowing off steam. While the operators there are overjoyed to see her, and take photos of her with both hands full of shopping bags as commemoration, they also remind her not to go overboard with her purchases.

lore.title: Promotion Record
lore.text:
[Iris's Notes]
On a subconscious level, Umiri is aware that the reason she cannot establish relations of trust with others is because she cannot bare her true heart to them.
She must overcome her past trauma and step out of her comfort zone, and once again reveal her heart to her friends.
When the day should come that Umiri wakes from the dream and forgets all that transpired within, may a part of what she experienced here remain with her and give her courage—
The courage to face others with her true heart.

lore.title: Profile
lore.text: A famous action movie star from Yan, FEater was forced to give up her film career after contracting Oripathy. She found a new purpose in life at Rhodes Island.

lore.title: Clinical Analysis
lore.text:
Imaging tests for this Operator showed blurry outlines of internal organs with visible dark spots. Unusually high concentrations of Originium particles were present in her circulatory system, indicating infection and confirming her as Infected at this stage.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 7.2%
Visible traces of Originium on the subject's right leg, but it has not yet crystallized.

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.21u/L
FEater's infection is still in early stages and has yet to substantially impact her health.

lore.title: Archive File 1
lore.text: FEater studied martial arts for many years prior to entering the film industry. She is the heir to the Tie Yi Liu He Quan, the Universal Fist of the Iron Will, one of Yan's great martial arts traditions. FEater has mastered all Five Elements, Eight Strikes, and Twelve Forms of her art, giving her the ability to deal devastating blows in the blink of an eye.

lore.title: Archive File 2
lore.text: After contracting Oripathy, FEater's acting career and aspirations came to a screeching halt. But she didn't give into depression like one might expect, since movies to her were just one vehicle for delivering righteousness. The optimistic former star quickly landed back on her feet.

lore.title: Archive File 3
lore.text: Even after becoming a movie star, even having been a legendary martial arts master, FEater has always been someone very approachable. In fact, she is actually rather naive and gets along easily with other Operators. Her hobbies include movies, of course, as well as Yan food, and chugging alcohol with a friendly crowd.

lore.title: Profile
lore.text: Enforcer, citizen of Laterano, entitled to the privileges listed in Clauses 1 through 13 of the Laterano Constitution, is an executor of the Notarial Hall who just passed his training term. During the Summit of Nations, he was involved in riots caused by heretics. Following the incident's conclusion, he was recommended by Operator Executor. In accordance to an agreement between Rhodes Island and the Notarial Hall, he now assists Rhodes Island as a specialist operator.

lore.title: Clinical Analysis
lore.text:
Imaging tests reveal clear, normal outlines of internal organs, and no abnormal shadows have been detected. Originium granules have not been detected in the circulatory system and there is no sign of infection. At this time, the operator is believed to be uninfected.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 0%
Operator Enforcer shows no signs of Originium infection.

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.12u/L
Operator Enforcer rarely comes into contact with Originium, but consumes coffee in excess. Moderation is encouraged.

lore.title: Archive File 1
lore.text:
Operator Enforcer, real name Ezell Pastore, quickly won over everyone's hearts shortly after arriving at Rhodes Island thanks to his gentle, friendly demeanor and helpful attitude. It is hard to imagine that Executor and Enforcer, both executors from the same Laterano Notarial Hall, have such dramatically different ways of handling people and situations. From this, we can infer that Laterano may have various ways of protecting their citizens' civil rights. Enforcer prefers a more diplomatic approach of listening and mediation, rather than resolving disputes through physical means. He tries to fully understand the intentions and arguments of all parties, before finally resolving the conflict by finding a solution everyone can accept.
However, this does not mean that Enforcer is incapable of fighting—far from it. During his operator exam, Enforcer displayed stunning combat prowess, particularly in close-quarters. Though he may lack experience in emergency situations, as far as his skills are concerned, he is very likely more than capable of dragging everyone to the negotiation table, one way or another.
Great, the Notarial Hall even has enforcers like him! The kid even offered to help me whip up a cup of coffee!
—Closure

lore.title: Archive File 2
lore.text:
As we understand it, Enforcer recently completed his training period as an executor of the Notarial Hall, certainly no small feat for someone so young. Under normal circumstances, when a citizen of Laterano receives their patron firearm at the age of twelve, they still need an extensive period of study to truly master using it. After passing a number of examinations and obtaining the corresponding qualification certificates, including the Laterano Firearm Carry and Usage Permit, they formally earn the authorization to use their gun in self-defense, escort duty, ceremonies, and other purposes. Additionally, every few years, gun-owning citizens of Laterano need to bring their patron firearms to the relevant branches of the Notarial Hall and complete gun inspections before they can continue to legally use their 'partners'.
However, the education and training required of a Notarial Hall executor goes far beyond that.
Working in the Notarial Hall is a difficult task, and each official requires a deep understanding of several layers of laws, regulations, and rules. In other words, it can be said that many in the Notarial Hall are profound legal scholars. On top of all this, an executor must also have excellent gun-handling skills, and most difficult of all, must deal with situations where they might be forced to point the muzzle at their own kind. This is not something that can be learned from a textbook.
Due to both the Sankta's laws and their own empathy, it is inherently difficult for one to harbor hostilities towards another, or even to hide their hostilities. Even if it would not violate the law, one still needs to overcome massive psychological pressure, as well as a sense of moral condemnation, to lift one's hand against a fellow Sankta. Perhaps Operator Executor represents the ideal state that skilled, experienced executors should aspire towards. However, Operator Enforcer still managed to pass his Notarial Hall training, all while maintaining his gentle demeanor.
With a smile on his face, he told the HR operator that he had no special secrets to accomplish this. Simply a bit more patience.

lore.title: Archive File 3
lore.text:
When Enforcer arrived at Rhodes Island to handle the necessary onboarding procedures, he had with him a young Sankta girl named Cecelia. What a mature and adorable child. Even though she won't be here for long, she has already become good friends with almost all the other children here, and they all look forward to seeing her again. This came as a surprise to us. From what we knew, Cecelia grew up in a very unique environment. Isolated at home for a long time because of her identity, she never had any contact with her peers, and was not given a chance to get along with them or develop bonds. However, Cecelia did not exhibit any social impairments, personality flaws, or psychological problems usually present in children growing up under similar circumstances. Her deceased guardian must've painstakingly nurtured her emotional growth. Undoubtedly, she has been given more than enough love and companionship.
According to Operator Enforcer's explanations, Cecelia's health is not in stable condition, and, following Dr. Kal'tsit's judgment, Rhodes Island will provide her with as much medical assistance as possible. Unfortunately though, there really is not much we can do for this lovely young lady. Dr. Kal'tsit can only provide a few bits of basic medical advice on diet and rest. Given that Cecelia will travel to areas near Kazdel, it will be difficult for Medical to conduct follow-up health monitoring. However, Cecelia assures us that she can take care of herself, and we have little choice but to trust in this precocious girl. After all, Enforcer will be accompanying her along the way. An executor should have the skills to handle whatever challenges may arise on the way.
It's worth noting that in the period before leaving for Kazdel, Enforcer often spoke with the operators in charge of educating the minors at Rhodes Island, consulting them in great detail on all the recommended textbooks and supplementary materials from primary education through secondary education, and downloading everything onto his terminal.

lore.title: Archive File 4
lore.text:
[Classified Log]
Cecelia's condition is very unique. Unexpectedly, Operator Enforcer seems to have a deeper understanding of this than we do, perhaps due to what they experienced during Laterano's Summit of Nations.
That's right. The girl named Cecelia has a mix of Sankta and Sarkaz blood. Despite the deep hatred between these two races, there are always those who can overcome the barriers built over thousands of years. To be honest, this girl is not alone. Emotions have a lot more power than one would expect.
The truly remarkable thing is that even as a mixed-blood, Cecelia's halo still shines bright above her head, though somewhat unstably. Children between Sankta and foreigners can never be Sankta, and this should have been ironclad law. Their haloes and wings of light are proof of their acceptance by the law, which shuns all else.
What, then, does Cecelia's existence mean?
We have too little information to work with.
Neither Cecelia nor Ezell seemed insistent on asking this question, which is likely the wisest course of action. For us, what truly matters isn't the meaning given to one's existence, but what meaning that existence can go on to create. The journey ahead of them is destined to be rough, and there will be no shortage of trials and tribulations. They may well tread a thorny path, and even come home empty-handed.
But their journey will never be in vain, and we wish all the luck in the world to these two youths.

lore.title: Promotion Record
lore.text:
Operator Enforcer always carries a coffee mug with him when he works, which always contains the same kind of black coffee—made from a very bitter bean, with not a single granule of sugar added. However, like most Laterans, he is also extremely fond of sweets such as cakes and cookies. In his own words, his choice of black coffee is only to help him focus on his work.
Yet when he finishes his work, Enforcer will pull out a separate coffee brewing set. He often spends hours at a time comparing the differences in flavor caused by varying degrees of roasting, configuring the perfect blend of coffee bean varieties, optimizing the proper ratio of cream and sugar, and even subscribing to the Bolívar Agricultural Magazine just to read the coffee planting columns—even though the magazine is often delivered months late. If Enforcer ever invites you to try the new blend of coffee he whipped up after work, be sure to accept his offer: you won't be disappointed.
However, if you ever accept a cup of coffee from him during work hours, be sure to determine whose cup it is.

lore.title: Profile
lore.text:
Former Columbian bodyguard, passed examination and joined Rhodes Island on Operator Silence's referral.
Expert at remote lethality in coordination with homemade traps. Presently active in the gamut of missions as a Specialist Operator.

lore.title: Clinical Analysis
lore.text:
Imaging tests reveal clear, normal outlines of internal organs, and no abnormal shadows have been detected. Originium granules have not been detected in the circulatory system and there is no sign of infection. At this time, this operator is believed to be uninfected.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 0%
Operator Robin shows no signs of Originium infection.

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.12u/L
Operator Robin rarely comes into contact with Originium.

lore.title: Archive File 1
lore.text:
A fairly reticent Anaty woman.
Perpetually downcast between her brows, she gives the impression that much weighs on her mind, though she gives her own explanation for it—in keeping her household afloat, she often considers a great deal of things, and has gotten used to it.
Talking to her, you realize that she's just the same as a city girl who likes to be with people her age.

lore.title: Archive File 2
lore.text:
After finding out about Robin's father's circumstances, Rhodes Island notified its Columbian office's operators to go and look into it.
Robin's father was in dire condition to say the least, and Rhodes Island was already hard-pressed to offer Robin treatment free of charge. There are too many suffering across this world, and Rhodes Island is no charity.
However, as long as both sides have ideas, then there is always some leeway for mediation. In the end, Rhodes Island issued for Robin a fairly particular contract—much longer work hours than other Operators, with a further predetermined cut of all of Robin's mission earnings paid automatically to Rhodes Island, directly furnishing her father's medical fees.
In return, Rhodes Island would immediately provide her father treatment.

lore.title: Archive File 3
lore.text:
Many Operators aboard Rhodes Island have complicated backgrounds. It's led to the point that if you stopped and paid attention to the chatter, you'd be forgiven for thinking we were in an age of chaos and flames of war.
But if you set aside the effect of Oripathy, you'd find most people across the land living in peace, all the while enjoying the eclectic conveniences of modernization—it's a cruel thing, but if only the vast wealth of cities disregarded the conflict stemming from Infected and the like, wouldn't things seem so peaceful?
Not to tread a time-worn supposition again; the point is that a portion of Rhodes Island's operators have, owing to their years of combat experience, been rather long estranged from modern life.
This is no good thing; a certain amount of recreation is indispensable, and Rhodes Island hardly restricts its operators' private lives. Yet, people continually lapped by the fire of conflict find it no easy thing to return to everyday life. Their greatest joys will often be confined to liquor, music, reading, and sleep.
People like the ever-freewheeling Chief Engineer Closure are few and far between across Rhodes Island, and on more than one occasion she's been frustrated at not finding someone of like mind to have fun watching movies and soaps together.
Robin's arrival alleviated one of her problems; after all, just as the first record states, Robin is by no means naturally gloomy—she was undeniably an open, cheerful city girl in the past, and her greatest hobby happens to be watching movies.

lore.title: Archive File 4
lore.text:
According to our Columbian operators' investigations and Robin's own explanation, it was only following the bankruptcy of her father's company and his repeated failures to reprise that he entered a downwards spiral.
At the time of his divorce, the option to go with her mother was wholly open to Robin, but she chose to stay by her father's side in the end.
She says that even though her father became so violent, easy to enrage, she still remembers how he used to be so gentle. So she opted to bear her father's hysteria, all the while heading out alone, earning money by herself to keep the house going.
In spite of her relatively light build, she looked up to the robust, talented protagonists she'd seen since childhood in movies, and so when times at home were good, she took martial arts classes, and by her own efforts built up a good physique, as well as impressive combat skill for any ordinary person. Though adulthood came and she was nothing close to a hero who could plumb Paradise and Inferno alike, it did streamline finding herself a job.
She first tried to pursue mental labor, but she quickly realized such work couldn't support her father's spendthrift habits. Afterwards, she began seeking all sorts of physical work, and ultimately found a decent job as a bodyguard.
The job, however, was barely enough to maintain their livelihood, and she still sought better-paying work all throughout. Moreover, Robin has made it clear that during that period, how dangerous the work was no longer mattered much to her, as long as it could make any money.
Indeed, she never imagined it'd be a turning point from where she'd meet Mountain and Silence, and eventually come to Rhodes Island.
In the end, even if her father can recover with Rhodes Island's aid, even greater problems will sooner or later arise should he fall back on his older self-abandoning ways, and it's clear that Robin would be powerless against them.
Though it often doesn't end well when outsiders interfere in these types of domestic affairs, Robin herself has turned to the Doctor and asked for help, so it should be feasible at the least for the Doctor to offer her some suggestion of direction.
We hope for a day when things can improve for her.

lore.title: Promotion Record
lore.text:
[Classified Log]
Anthony raised something with me, concerning Robin's mid-jailbreak 'betrayal.'
He knows of it, Kafka knows, and in order to explain the jailbreak's events, he's told Silence and Mayer of it. Beyond that, though, he hasn't gone out of his way to tell Domma or Pinecone, and he hopes the two of them will never, ever know the jailbreak saw something like it happen.
He also hopes, if there comes a day when he's made known to the world, that this specific matter isn't raised.
I have no reason to refuse.
That said, Robin still seems to be taking it quite deeply to heart, and this I can't help with. We can only watch to see if she, herself, can move on from it.

lore.title: Profile
lore.text:
One of the members of Team Rainbow, Frost is a firm, focused and energetic individual adept at combat in outdoor environments.
She mainly uses modified mechanical traps named 'Welcome Mats.' Through strategic placement, they can obstruct the enemy and provide tactical support to the entire team.

lore.title: Clinical Analysis
lore.text:
Imaging tests reveal clear, normal outlines of internal organs, and no abnormal shadows have been detected. Originium granules have not been detected in the circulatory system and there is no sign of infection. At this time, this operator is believed to be uninfected.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 0%
Frost shows no sign of Originium infection.

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] Undisclosed
Relevant data will not be disclosed due to the Medical Department's agreement.

lore.title: Archive File 1
lore.text:
Operator Tina, codename Frost. A member of Rainbow Six, and one of the witnesses to the 'Watchtower 33' incident, Frost registered with Rhodes Island as a cooperative party following the incident.
The members of Team Rainbow are mostly reluctant to reveal their past, which we will not object to given that our partners have the right to secrecy regarding their internal information.
As with the other members of Team Rainbow, operator Frost has extremely comprehensive combat experience, far surpassing the average operator in various fields including teamwork. Based on the report submitted to the HR department, operator Frost seems to have participated in numerous outdoor rescue missions and is a talented wilderness survival specialist.
However, please note that the members of Team Rainbow are only working with us on a temporary basis and are not formal employees of Rhodes Island. They still have many things they are busy with, so please do not rely overly much on their strength.

lore.title: Archive File 2
lore.text: Without a doubt, Frost is an experienced hunter, yet she is even more than that. During her stay at Rhodes Island, Frost spent most of her time hunkered down in one of Rhodes Island's workshops, producing a full set of hunting equipment and six or seven models of hunting traps. She has a never-ending list of topics to discuss regarding hunting, and can often be found exchanging hunting experiences with operators from Sami and Kazimierz.

lore.title: Archive File 3
lore.text:
Be it stealth, tracking, or hunting... Operator Frost already exhibits excellent potential even without the use of Originium Arts. Combined with her extensive use of traps, this unique form of combat is very suited for operating on Terra's wastelands.
Incidentally, Miss Frost's cooking skills are not bad. I believe that even if she is lacking supplies, Miss Frost will still be able to find a way to survive in the wasteland.
Recently, she has been doing a detailed study on 'Rhodes Island Wilderness Survival Guide.' I'm not sure if the information in that book will be of use to her.

lore.title: Archive File 4
lore.text:
[Classified Log]
After much deliberation, I've decided to record the following as an archived record, since the notes and investigations here are born out of my own personal interest, even though I believe they are very much necessary.
The four operators of Team Rainbow are far more peculiar than we think, and many people are unaware that their living environment may in fact be vastly different from our own.
Though they are by definition armed personnel, each of them has received comprehensive higher education. I am astonished by the professionalism of Operator Blitz's linguistic knowledge, whereas operator Ash is skilled enough to converse fluently in two to three different languages with other people. I don't believe I need to mention the multitude of professional knowledge possessed by the other members of Team Rainbow.
They are not Infected, and have no prejudice against them. They were easily able to accept the idea of Rhodes Island extending help towards the Infected, and clearly expressed their sympathy towards them.
It's difficult to imagine what kind of country they came from.

lore.title: Promotion Record
lore.text:
[Project and Equipment Transfer Log]
Within this period, operator Frost has produced a large number of equipment by herself, including various large hunting traps, some simple snares and several hunting knives.

She has also applied for the allocation of some Originium explosives. We have assessed operator Frost's knowledge on the relevant fields, and believe that she will be able to utilize these resources properly.

lore.title: Profile
lore.text: Explorer, ore collector, and also a famous content creator on the video side of Columbia's intercity net. Contracted Oripathy due to inattentiveness on a geological excursion, and came to Rhodes Island seeking treatment. After some negotiation, she joined Rhodes Island as a specialist operator, using her ample geological knowledge and survival experience to support our teams on their many outdoor exploration missions.

lore.title: Clinical Analysis
lore.text:
Imaging tests show the indistinct outlines of internal organs, obscured by abnormal shadows. Originium granules detected in the circulatory system. The subject is confirmed to be infected with Oripathy.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 5%
Thanks to noticing the symptoms early and receiving timely treatment, Operator Wulfenite's condition is relatively under control.

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.15u/L
Due to the nature of her work, Operator Wulfenite must frequently enter areas with high concentrations of Originium. Even with her knowledge of protective measures, there is always the possibility her condition will worsen, and she will require close attention.
Hopefully understands her limits going forward.

lore.title: Archive File 1
lore.text:
Operators involved in the field of geology such as Earthspirit, Eyjafjalla, and several of our other scholarly types occasionally come together for a seminar to share their research. Once Wulfenite found out about this, she applied to take part in it.
At first, the others assumed she wished to learn from them. She called herself an ore collector, after all, and many collectors were in touch with and worked alongside geologists—an arrangement all present were familiar with.
But they quickly realized that she was no ordinary collector.
She was an incredible font of geological knowledge. While she would awkwardly twiddle her thumbs when the researchers spoke about theory, whenever a piece of ore she was familiar with was put on the table, she would happily go on and on about all its properties. The ore that inspired her codename, wulfenite, is a topic she is especially well-versed in. She knows everything about it, having even visited every single source of the ore within Columbia's borders. It was then that the other operators realized she did actually have a solid grounding in theory. She simply wasn't systematically deriving and discussing it like an academic would.
She also turned out to have some extremely obscure knowledge. Some of it was related to questions the researchers had always wondered about but never had the time to look into, while other parts involved things they had heard of but wouldn't know how to begin researching. To their surprise, Wulfenite took the time to go through that list of topics and verify them one by one.
However, the greatest change her participation caused in these seminars was that, at her urging, some of the quieter operators who only really talked about research also started sharing amusing anecdotes from their surveys. Several seminars even had to be extended for an hour due to this.
Afterwards, the participating operators would say they originally considered these incidents to irrelevant, but Wulfenite showed them that these trifles, or rather, personal experiences, were also worth sharing.
'Not only is she a new friend, she also pushed us to get to know each other better. She's one hell of a girl, I tell you.'

lore.title: Archive File 2
lore.text:
Wulfenite isn't shy about sharing her videos from when she first started recording her adventures.
Rather than records of her exploits, they would be more accurately described as recordings of her rambling to herself. A girl out in the wilds holding up a camera, recounting to the lens what happened to her that day.
They are very different from the videos she uploads onto the intercity net, in that they are much more personal, but through them, we catch a glimpse of the start of her recorded life of derring-do.
'At first, I recorded myself so I wouldn't get too... you know, lonely. I know there's not much you can do about it when you're searching for ore, but sometimes, the loneliness really gets to you.
'A friend once told me I didn't have the right personality for solo exploring. And I don't. I usually look for stuff in the middle of nowhere, and nobody wanted to be my survey partner. But I didn't want to give up because of that, so I came up with this instead.
'At first, I was just talking to myself, but soon, I started imagining my parents or my friends behind the lens. That they were right there with me, and I'd chat with them.
'Frankly, I wouldn't have even thought to upload my first video if a tech-savvy friend of mine hadn't done it for me. Who knew so many people would be into that stuff? But with her encouragement, I made my own account and started doing this sort of stuff with a bit more purpose.
'Right, that's the video. I'd been combing the wilds for days with nothing to show for it. I wasn't in the best mood, and was really homesick, so I recorded it. Man, all that crying I did to the camera was a real long time ago, now that I think about it.'

lore.title: Archive File 3
lore.text:
Rhodes Island is no stranger to sociable people who like participating in or organizing group activities, but Wulfenite has managed to make a name for herself even in that crowded space.
She's had her share of memorable moments, but the one that left the deepest impression on others is the ore exhibition and exchange she held soon after she joined Rhodes Island.
Generally, so long as a sensible plan is provided in writing, Rhodes Island is always willing to provide its operators space to hold events for whatever activities they are passionate about, as well as some support.
However, when Wulfenite submitted her proposal to Logistics, the operator who received it felt a twinge of doubt. The proposal itself was extremely comprehensive, and she did indeed have enough samples to stock the exhibit, but the amount of space she requested was simply ridiculous.
At first, the logistics operator simply assumed she was unaware of the scale she was asking for, but she repeatedly claimed to know what she was doing, and that she had proof: many patients and operators alike had already expressed through various means their desire to participate.
After tallying up the responses, Logistics accepted her application, and after asking Amiya for further instructions, the exhibition finally got the green light.
It was then that something happened, something that shocked all of Logistics. A week before the event, a padishah suddenly paid a visit to Rhodes Island. At the same time, a truck transporting a massive chunk of wulfenite ore, escorted by the padishah's men-at-arms, stopped a safe distance away from the landship.
Wulfenite's proposal did mention that she would be displaying something related to her codename, which also happened to be what got her into ore collecting in the first place: a giant hunk of wulfenite ore. But everyone had assumed she would simply break off a piece of her special rock to display.
Instead, the ore was going to be exhibited in its entirety. Not only that, but the padishah was greatly looking forward to perusing the exhibition, just like everyone else.
'Hmm? No, my granddad used to be one of the royal guards, sure, but that's all. He wasn't anyone special to the padishah.
'It was only after I went back to the city and helped the padishah find some ore that we became friends.'
After her rather understated explanation, she turned back to the crowd and started managing the exhibition.
As an ordinary person who could call a padishah friend and make so many more in such a short time aboard Rhodes Island, Wulfenite's social skills are apparent at a glance.

lore.title: Archive File 4
lore.text:
There is one thing Wulfenite's fans often talk about: she was a real pioneer in registering her account and uploading videos, and her videos are very high quality, but there are extreme gaps between her uploads, often months at a time. Due to her upload schedule, she was never very popular.
However, that all changed one day when she suddenly started uploading videos en masse, with even better content and presentation than ever before. This was usually a sure sign of a content creator going commercial, but she never showed any indication of going down that path, nor of wanting to chase more popularity. The fans were unsure what to make of the situation.
The answer was simple, and only requires a glance at her medical history: it was around that time when she contracted Oripathy. Her fans, and even the people she worked with, had no idea about her illness.
'Only after catching Oripathy did I realize that so many people on the intercity net were also fellow sufferers. We became friends, and I learned something: to people like us... the net's a place where we can have our former lives back, even if just for a little bit.'
Exploring the wilds, hauling your finds back to town, sharing your results... Once, she would have done the sharing on classroom podiums or even TV studios, but now, she chooses to record videos and use social media for communication. Most assume she's a net addict, unwilling to live in reality, but they never expect to hear that she simply has no other choice.
Wulfenite has many public social media accounts she actively uses to record and share her life. Observant fans have noticed that whenever these accounts begin to make a stir, it means she's back from a trip.
Her posts are just as passionate as her videos, which makes those watching her believe that she acts exactly the same way whether on the net or in real life. What they don't know is that behind the facade is someone racked with worry day in and day out. She had no choice but to bear the pressure of keeping her Oripathy hidden.
When she was out exploring, she lived in her videos. When she returned to the city, she lived on social media. Compared to most other net celebrities who were only aiming to boost their popularity, Wulfenite appeared to be a completely virtual being. For a while, her fans were obsessed with finding out where she lived in real life, but over time, they gradually stopped caring.
From the moment she arrived on Rhodes Island, her voracious desire for social interaction was apparent. One can even say her life and her personality were at complete odds.
However, despite it all, she has managed to stay optimistic and tenacious throughout.
'It's true that I didn't have a choice at first, but when I started to take the net seriously, I found that it's actually a real interesting place. It's no big deal if you're Infected online—nobody cares.'

lore.title: Promotion Record
lore.text:
Wulfenite carries a lot of specialized survey equipment with her: a compass, a scratch kit, a pickaxe, miniature explosives, even a portable rock crusher.
Having learned from dealing with other exploration-inclined operators, Engineering is always ready to help repair equipment whenever they return from a trip. However, with Wulfenite they noticed her tools were always near-pristine, with barely a mark on them, yet she clearly wasn't coming back empty-handed.
How does she do it? With this question eating away at them, a certain Engineering operator volunteered to come along on her next sojourn.
The operator was unsure whether to laugh or cry when the truth became clear.
It was not that Wulfenite did not want to use her tools. She simply had no need to.
Her tail was able to wind around strategic spots on rock faces to help her climb.
It could also easily crush solid rock into powder.
It could smash through cliff faces, allowing her to bypass difficult terrain.
Yes, it is her impressive tail that lets her solve most of the issues she runs into.
The fact of the matter is, at least according to that operator's observations, Wulfenite would have a much easier time if she simply stopped lugging around all that equipment. She herself is skeptical, though.
As long as she has her tools, she can feel at ease. If she ever lost them, she would become anxious, and her exploration would go much less smoothly.
If her tools had souls, and knew that their only purpose was to provide emotional support, they wouldn't know whether to laugh or to cry either.
Better to be prepared than unprepared, though. Perhaps they will actually come in handy one day.

lore.title: Profile
lore.text:
Specialist Operator Bena, retained aboard Rhodes Island after her attempt to bring Iris back to Victoria turned out fruitless.
Uses unique doll manipulation techniques, able to demonstrate a special strategic value on the battlefield.
Considering her age and her own wishes, only to be deployed under special circumstances.

lore.title: Clinical Analysis
lore.text:
